# Offline Three.js r160 components

`GLTFExporter.js`, `TextureUtils.js` and LICENSE come from [Three.js r160](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160/examples/jsm).
Furnish omits the volume extension for zero-thickness transmissive materials and uses the glTF default for infinite attenuation distance.

`gltf-exporter.offline.js` wraps the two modules in a factory taking the existing
Three.js instance. Generated by `node scripts/build-blender-exporter.cjs`.
It does not load a second engine or access the network. No build is needed to run Furnish.

## SMAA

`smaa.offline.js` packages the three r160 SMAA shaders and the two unmodified
PNG lookup textures from [SMAAPass](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r160/examples/jsm/postprocessing/SMAAPass.js).
The shader factory accepts the existing Three.js instance. The vertex shaders
use Furnish's fullscreen triangle. The neighborhood shader accepts a blend
scale for use with hardware MSAA. See `LICENSE` and `SMAA-LICENSE.txt`.
